picks.title: Netanyahu to meet Trump in a first encounter since the Iran war began
picks.summary: Netanyahu and Trump meet for the first time since the Iran war began, with both leaders facing domestic pressure — Netanyahu ahead of reelection amid a strained relationship with Trump, and Trump under pressure to end an unpopular war.

picks.title: With wildfires raging in France and Spain, fire crews race against next heat wave
picks.summary: French President Macron called the wildfires devastating France "completely unprecedented," describing the country's worst fire-related crisis since World War II, as crews in France and Spain brace for another heat wave.

picks.bucket: US as the world sees it
picks.title: Trump calls protester 'communist' after Michigan speech interruption
picks.summary: A protester was removed after interrupting a Trump speech at a Michigan auto event, with international outlets like Al Jazeera closely tracking the moment as a snapshot of US political polarization.

picks.title: Paper leak crisis: Parliament's trial by fire | Monsoon Session | Anti Paper Leak Bill 2026
picks.origTitle: 'पेपर लीक' संसद की 'अग्नि-परीक्षा' | Monsoon Session | Anti Paper Leak Bill 2026
picks.summary: State broadcaster coverage of Parliament's monsoon session debating a new anti-paper-leak bill aimed at cracking down on exam-paper-leak scandals.

picks.title: 10 years jail, 10 crore rupee fine: what's special about the new proposed anti-paper-leak law?
picks.origTitle: 10 साल की जेल, 10 करोड़ रुपये का जुर्माना: पेपर लीक रोकने वाले नए प्रस्तावित क़ानून में क्या है ख़ास?
picks.summary: The central government has amended the 2024 Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) law to add tougher penalties — up to 10 years in prison and a 10-crore-rupee fine — for exam paper leaks; the article breaks down the new provisions.
flags: Same story as the state-media pick above — useful to compare framing/detail

picks.title: Foreign Ministry responds to US and European calls to create an Asian NATO analog
picks.origTitle: В МИД высказались о призывах США и Европы создать азиатский аналог НАТО
picks.summary: Russia's Foreign Ministry commented on Western calls to build an Asian equivalent of NATO, framing it as part of broader US/European containment strategy.
flags: State-media source — treat framing with caution

picks.title: Moscow and the surrounding region hit by nearly 400 Ukrainian drones; one strikes an apartment building in Chekhov, warehouse fire in Podolsk
picks.origTitle: Москву и Подмосковье атаковали почти 400 украинских беспилотников. В Чехове дрон попал в многоэтажный дом, в Подольске горит склад
picks.summary: A mass Ukrainian drone attack targeted the Moscow region, with one drone striking an apartment building in Chekhov (two flats damaged, no reported casualties per the regional governor) and a warehouse fire in Podolsk.
flags: Casualty/damage figures come from Russian regional officials and are unverified independently

picks.title: US concerned about China laying undersea cables in the Pacific; China's foreign ministry responds
picks.origTitle: 美国担心中方在太平洋地区布设海底光缆 中国外交部回应
picks.summary: At a routine briefing, a Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson responded to a reporter's question about US concerns over China laying undersea cables in the Pacific region.
flags: State-media source; China's response framing not independently verified

picks.title: M7.1 earthquake near Kumamoto hits intensity 7 in Uki and Hikawa; tsunami advisory for Ariake and Yatsushiro seas
picks.origTitle: 熊本 宇城市と氷川町で震度7 有明・八代海に津波注意報
picks.summary: A magnitude 7.1 earthquake struck the Kumamoto region at a depth of 10km, registering the maximum intensity-7 shaking in Uki City and Hikawa Town, with intensity-6 shaking across several other municipalities; a tsunami advisory (up to 1m) was issued for the Ariake and Yatsushiro seas, and Kyushu Shinkansen and all JR Kyushu trains were halted.

picks.title: Immigration agency plans to raise income threshold for permanent residency when supporting 5+ foreign family dependents
picks.origTitle: 永住許可の年収水準、外国の親族含む扶養5人以上で加算　入管庁方針
picks.summary: Japan's Immigration Services Agency plans to require a higher minimum income for permanent residency applicants who support five or more dependents, including foreign relatives, as part of tightening residency criteria.

picks.title: Audit reveals Brattleboro hospital's multiyear budget deficit has risen to at least $30 million
picks.summary: A new audit found Brattleboro Memorial Hospital's multiyear budget deficit has grown to at least $30 million, which a hospital administrator attributed partly to financial reporting systems being "in shambles."

picks.title: Do 55,521 unowned properties exist in Puerto Rico? CRIM begins project to identify them
picks.origTitle: ¿Existen 55,521 propiedades sin dueños en Puerto Rico? El CRIM comienza proyecto para identificarlas
picks.summary: Puerto Rico's municipal revenue agency (CRIM) is launching a project to identify tens of thousands of properties with no registered owner, one of several mechanisms approved by the fiscal oversight board to raise funds for municipal governments.

picks.title: Why China is giving away its best AI models
picks.summary: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3, a Chinese open-weight model that reportedly beats some top US systems at a fraction of the cost, has intensified the US-China AI rivalry and raised questions about the strategy behind giving away frontier-level open models.

picks.title: Microsoft unveils AI security tools it says outperform competing platforms
picks.summary: Microsoft announced new AI-focused security tools it claims cost less and outperform competing platforms, part of the broader vendor race to secure enterprise AI deployments.

picks.title: X Money is launching in the US starting today
picks.summary: X Money, Elon Musk's payments push for turning X into an "everything app," is rolling out in the US with a digital wallet, peer-to-peer payments similar to Venmo, and a metal Visa card.

picks.title: Crunchyroll to Stream Romelia War Chronicle Anime
picks.summary: Crunchyroll announced it will stream Romelia War Chronicle, with the anime's world premiere screening at Otakon on July 31.

picks.title: True to the Source Material: An Interview with Suikoden: The Anime's Producers
picks.summary: Producers of the Suikoden anime discuss what inspired KONAMI to bring the beloved RPG franchise back as a new anime series.

picks.title: # 666 Ottomans Piglet
picks.summary: New episode of Tuesdays with Stories with Mark Normand and Joe List swapping old comedy-circuit stories.
